the 97-bps footprint contains four protein-binding sites, and that HNF-1 plus C/EBP plus protein II are essential and sufficient for enhancer activity.

the human apoliprotein B gene second intron enhancer contains multiple protein-binding sequences that are necessary for its activity in hepatocytes.
